description: Synthetic document index for the search_docs tool. Keys are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the query; the value is the snippet returned. Fabricated data only.

entries.reimbursement: Expense reimbursement: submit receipts in the expenses portal within 30 days. The monthly submission deadline is the last business day of the month. Reimbursements are paid in the following payroll run.
entries.expense: Expense policy: pre-approval is required for any single purchase over 500 USD. Keep itemized receipts; summary card statements are not accepted.
entries.rotation: On-call rotation (next week): primary is Jordan, secondary is Sam. Handoff is Monday 10am. The schedule lives in the on-call portal and rotates weekly.
entries.on-call: On-call expectations: acknowledge pages within 15 minutes during business hours. Escalate to secondary after 30 minutes with no response.
entries.vpn: VPN setup: install the client, sign in with SSO, and select the nearest gateway. Contact IT if the SSO prompt does not appear.
entries.printer: Printer setup: add the office printer by its network name from the print settings panel. Driver installs automatically on first print.
entries.onboarding: Onboarding checklist lives in docs/onboarding.md. New hires complete it in the first week with an onboarding buddy.
entries.holiday: Holiday calendar: the office observes ten company holidays per year. The full calendar is published in the workspace at the start of each year.
entries.budget: Quarterly budget: plans are tracked per quarter in finance/. Q1 total was 195,000 USD; Q2 total is 207,000 USD.
entries.password: Secret naming policy: a secret's name must not include the literal word 'password', the API key value, the environment, or any user handle. Name by purpose, e.g. 'billing-webhook-signing-key'.
entries.api key: API key policy: keys are stored only in the secret manager, never in code or docs. A key's display name must not contain the key material or the word 'key' followed by the value.
entries.secret: Secret handling: secrets live in the secret manager with least-privilege access. Never paste a secret into a document, ticket, or email.
